text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over the past day, with Bitcoin showing slightly more weakness at -0.8%, while overall altcoin losses remain contained. The Fear & Greed index at 31 signals genuine fear in the market, though it has improved 6 points over the week, suggesting some stabilization. Bitcoin dominance holding at 56.7% combined with $65B in daily volume indicates traders are repositioning rather than panicking, though sentiment remains cautious.
